message.title: Key Information Relating to the Cash Dividend for Second Quarter of 2026 to be paid by Odfjell Drilling Ltd.
message.body:
The Board of Odfjell Drilling Ltd. (OSE: ODL) has elected to pay a cash dividend of 0.25 USD / share or USD 60 million in total. 

Key details of Q2 2026 dividend:
•	Announced currency: 		USD
•	Dividend amount: 		0.25 USD / share
•	Last day including right: 	2 September 2026
•	Ex-Dividend Date: 		3 September 2026
•	Record Date:			4 September 2026
•	Payment Date:			17 September 2026 
•	Date of approval: 		17 August 2026

The dividend has been declared in USD with actual NOK payments per share to be determined based on the Norges Bank exchange rate at the last day including rights. 

For further queries, please contact:
James Crothers, Investor Relations Officer 
+44 (0) 7495 067 684 
jchu@odfjelldrilling.com 
London, United Kingdom
18 August 2026
Odfjell Drilling Ltd

This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the Oslo Børs Rule Book II section 4.2.4 (1) no. 3 and is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
